title: Tangut strokes
description: Strokes drawn with a mouse, trackpad or stylus on a browser pad, each with the Tangut character it was made for. 211 drawings of 180 characters, polylines in the unit square. Collected to train and test character recognition for a search box. Baseline: 32.1% first, 57.5% in five, MRR 0.440 on the fixed 106-drawing test split.
